sources.title: Games

sources.label: Cores & emulators: consoles
sources.description: For an administrator: a row for each console, whether it plays here and on what, opening its own rows. With a console: the core it plays on (a choice), each of its cores to install (its licence accepted), update or remove, with a download's progress, and its BIOS files. Nothing for anyone else.

params.name: console
params.label: Console
params.help: A console's ID, $item on a page opened about it. Empty: every console.

sources.title: Consoles & cores

sources.label: Cores & emulators: standalone emulators
sources.description: For an administrator: each standalone emulator, its consoles, licence and firmware, and rows to accept its licence and install it, update it, stop a download or remove it. Nothing for anyone else.
sources.title: Standalone emulators

commands.label: Install the core
commands.description: Cores & emulators, administrators: downloads a console's core (item: its ID) from the libretro build server, or downloads it again to update it.

commands.label: Remove the core
commands.description: Cores & emulators, administrators: removes a core this server installed (item: its ID).

commands.label: Choose the console's core
commands.description: Cores & emulators, administrators: the core a console (item: its ID) plays on unless a game has its own; params.value is an installed core's ID, empty for automatic. A select row adds value.

commands.label: Accept the licence and install
commands.description: Cores & emulators, administrators: installs or updates a standalone emulator (item: its ID) in the background; params.license is the licence the row named, which must be the emulator's.

commands.label: Stop installing
commands.description: Cores & emulators, administrators: stops a standalone emulator's download (item: its ID).

commands.label: Remove the emulator
commands.description: Cores & emulators, administrators: uninstalls a standalone emulator (item: its ID). Saves stay.

rows.label: Show which consoles play here
rows.help: A row on the Games page, for everyone, of the consoles this server plays.

rows.label: Only consoles that play here
rows.help: On the page of every console, leave out those this server can't play yet.

rows.label: Setting up consoles
rows.help: Consoles, cores and standalone emulators are set up in Settings, Consoles & cores and Standalone emulators.
